result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: it creates a mutual cap based on 12 months’ paid or payable fees and provides uncapped carve-outs for, at minimum, confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, and willful misconduct. It also appropriately adds other preferred carve-outs and excludes Client’s payment obligations from the cap. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor and a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages. The changes are targeted to liability allocation and preserve unrelated commercial intent. Drafting is generally professional, though “Excluded Claims” would be clearer if defined as claims arising from the listed conduct or obligations.
